title: On the Riemann-Finsler Geometry of Tangent Bundle of Lie Groups with Two-Dimensional Commutator Subgroup
summary: We begin by studying the Riemannian geometry of the tangent Lie group $TG$ associated with a Lie group $G$ whose commutator subgroup is two-dimensional, equipped with the lift of a left-invariant Riemannian metric on $G$. We establish the relationship between the sectional curvatures of $G$ and those of $TG$. Next, we define a Randers metric on $G$ from a left-invariant Riemannian metric and a left-invariant vector field, and lift it vertically and completely to $TG$.
